debateDrawers.challenge.title: Challenge this
debateDrawers.guide.attributionBody: Every claim names the model that wrote it (colored dot). Pro supports its parent claim; Con opposes it.
debateDrawers.guide.attributionTitle: Who said what, and which side
debateDrawers.guide.challengeBody: Click Challenge on a claim — or select any sentence inside an argument — to send focused scrutiny at that exact spot.
debateDrawers.guide.compareBody: Open any claim for its generation history and compare versions. Toggle Tree / Outline, and Export for Markdown.
debateDrawers.guide.liveGenerationBody: The skeleton appears first, then each model writes its claim in with a cursor while the bar tracks progress.
debateDrawers.guide.title: A debate is an argument tree several models build together.
debateDrawers.investigation.instructions: Record how this claim held up under scrutiny. The claim carries the badge so the rest of the tree reads it in context.
debateDrawers.investigation.recorded: {status} — this is recorded on the claim.
debateDrawers.investigation.title: Investigation
debateDrawers.node.feedbackQuestion: Was this scoring explanation useful for reviewing the claim?
debateDrawers.node.noCompletedReview: No completed second-maker review is recorded for this node.
debateDrawers.node.noScoringRecommendati: No scoring recommendation is available for this argument.
debateDrawers.node.pathExpanded: This path expanded because of a {kind} decision.
debateDrawers.node.pathNoted: Noted: a {kind} decision was recorded. This did not change the tree.
debateDrawers.node.pathNotedWithReason: Noted (decision: {kind}): {reason}. This did not change the tree.
debateDrawers.node.selectToChallenge: Select any sentence above to challenge it.
debateDrawers.node.stoppedPathExplanatio: This investigation path was paused or abandoned. It is preserved here for reference — abandoned paths are never deleted. You can resume investigation by regenerating this argument.
debateDrawers.node.targetFocusFailed: Unable to focus that recommendation target because it is no longer visible.
debateDrawers.node.targetNotVisible: This recommendation references a claim that is not visible in the current debate tree.
debateDrawers.node.unlockHistory: Unlock actions to view generation history.
debateDrawers.recommendations.empty: No recommended investigations are available from the current scoring data.
debateDrawers.recommendations.title: Recommended investigations
debateDrawers.synthesis.leanDialecticalT: Derived from propagated dialectical (DF-QuAD) strength of the surviving pro vs con arguments.
debateDrawers.synthesis.leanStructuralTi: Structural: based on surviving argument counts, not dialectical strength.
debateDrawers.synthesis.pendingNote: Synthesis runs once the tree completes…
debateDrawers.synthesis.subtitle: The strongest case on each side, plus a verdict.
debateDrawers.synthesis.title: Synthesis
debateDrawers.synthesis.verdictWithheldN: Endorsed verdict withheld — no evidence in this run.
debateDrawers.verdict.claimTypeUnknownCa: Caveat — claim type unestablished: this claim's type could not be determined from stored analysis, so the evidence gate was not applied.
debateDrawers.verdict.contestedExplanati: The run did not settle this either way: the positions were too close, the judges disagreed, the leading position was not strong enough, or part of the comparison was missing.
debateDrawers.verdict.evidenceUnverified: Caveat — evidence unverified: extracted evidence has no resolved external source.
debateDrawers.verdict.title: Verdict
debateDrawers.verdict.unsupportedExplana: Even the leading position here came out weak once the arguments were weighed against each other — a weak case, not a disproved one.
debateDrawers.workspace.empty: No workspace artifacts for this debate.
debateDrawers.workspace.title: Workspace
